---
title: "Platforms"
readiness: context_only
---

This chapter estimates the complete topside mass and delivered platform cost for centralised hydrogen production and offshore HVDC conversion. The calculation is split into:

* [Complete Topside Mass](topside_mass.qmd) — converts the architecture-specific capacity into complete topside mass, including hosted equipment, auxiliaries and topside structure.
* [Platform EPCI CAPEX](platform_material_capex.qmd) — uses that mass to scale a commercial engineering, procurement, construction and installation (EPCI) package, including jacket and foundation delivery.

Separating mass from cost makes the physical sizing assumption and the commercial cost assumption independently traceable. Fabrication, integration and installation remain combined because the available evidence does not support a reliable separate cost breakdown. The mass-based cost relationship is a screening assumption; it does not establish installation feasibility.

Hosted equipment contributes to topside mass, while its purchase cost remains on the component pages and is excluded from the platform cost benchmark. [Platform and Substation Installation](../offshore_installation/platform_and_substation_installation.qmd) explains the installation boundary: no separate platform installation cost is added to EPCI. Platform OPEX and decommissioning remain separate, unresolved inputs to lifetime cost.
